test_cases.brief_summary: 1,800-word profile of a marine biologist studying microplastics in North Sea fish stocks, science and environment quarterly, Chicago style, no house style rules, partly AI-drafted with jargon-heavy methodology sections — simulated deliverable, house-style step skipped, ai-writing-detox included
test_cases.editorial_naturalness_note: One structural tell: the ai-writing-detox diagnosis of science-register AI tells is accurate but the replacement suggestions for methodology language risk swapping one form of stiffness for another — 'we analyzed' replacing 'analysis was conducted' is correct but the surrounding sentences still carry the explainer-blog cadence that LLMs default to for science communication.

test_cases.brief_summary: 2,500-word investigative piece about a city council member's undisclosed property interests, news register, AP style, no house style rules, factual claims requiring verification — simulated deliverable, house-style step skipped
test_cases.editorial_naturalness_note: Investigative register suits the agent well; the fact-check checklist for a piece with named officials and financial claims would be the strongest section. Package slightly thinner without house-style step but still complete for the brief.

test_cases.brief_summary: 600-word opinion column on public transit funding for a trade magazine, Chicago style, no AI involvement, no house style — simulated deliverable, 4 of 7 steps skipped (ai-writing-detox, house-style, fact-check, pull-quotes)
test_cases.editorial_naturalness_note: With only structure-checker, copy-editor, and headline-generator running, the package feels operationally thin — a working editor would expect more from an editorial pass. The agent's strength is orchestrating multiple skills; when most are skipped, the package underdelivers relative to the 'complete editorial package' promise.
